Chapter 7162: The Other Side

Chapter 7162: The Other Side

Li Qiye’s swing initially followed the rule imposed by Skykiller Spear, strictly brute force. However, even without the dao and cultivation, the hand represented Li Qiye’s will. Brute force was only its manifestation.

If he wanted to break everything, it would break everything regardless of the present suppression.

The suppression suddenly shattered as the spear was bent to the limit, on the verge of breaking.

“Bam!” The smash sent Skykiller flying through space and time, breaking everything along the way.

“What is going on?” Spectators couldn’t understand while looking at Skykiller who managed to stand up again.

Only Apex and Hao Cai saw glimpses of it. Earlier, Li Qiye was also subjected to the mortal reversion aura.

When only brute force was possible, it was akin to an ant unable to escape a dragon’s domain. Thus, Li Qiye’s smash could be compared to an ant somehow being able to destroy the entire mortal realm.

“This is your let-go state?” Skykiller stared at Li Qiye in astonishment.

“Letting go is akin to being reborn. You believe that your suppression works but in my eyes, it is only the manifestation of a child, no, an embryo.” Li Qiye smiled.

“What?” Skykiller didn’t believe it.

“A lifeform might be alive in another world and possess the highest power but after letting go, it can be born anew with nothing. However, you did not die, so it is not a true birth. You are still the other side of the same coin.” Li Qiye said.

“Other side.” This was Skykiller’s first time hearing this.

“Thus, you merely just descended and haven’t formed entirely.” Li Qiye said.

“I see, so that’s how it is.” Skykiller appreciated the enlightenment: “So I can never defeat you in this form.”

“Can’t defeat me regardless of the form.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“What are they talking about? Rebirth?” Immortals and overlords discussed among themselves.

“Not quite. It is not a rebirth in terms of life.” Apex patiently explained it to them: “It’s more of a cycle of the dao. Immortality is the end of the path but what if we reverse it? Would that mean the end is now the beginning?”

“Don’t be so sure.” Meanwhile, Skykiller said: “There is more than just immortal dao power and let-go power in this world.”

“Yes, you may use his power.” Li Qiye nodded.

“I will show you then, Skykiller!” Skykiller shouted, revealing the hidden innate talent.

Its dominion took over everything, not just Divine Firmament but all of Heavenrealm. Even external worlds were affected.

“Royal Bloodlines!” Skykiller roared.

“Rumble!” Everyone felt the king shouldering their sins and activating their bloodlines. All gained something akin to the divine beasts’ bloodlines.

Mortals became incredibly powerful and could pulverize a mountain range with a single punch.

“Raa!” As everyone grew stronger, their improved bloodlines channeled back to Skykiller.

Skykiller maintained the original form, albeit far stronger than before. When immortals stared at the blessed form, they thought Skykiller could replace the high heaven.

“Apex power?” Someone murmured.

“This is the result of fusing two apex powers.” A celestial immortal explained upon seeing both Skykiller and Royal Bloodlines used in harmony.
